name: youtube
description: Summary, chapters, and transcript of one YouTube video. Falls back to speech recognition when the video has no captions.

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: Digest of one video URL, with the transcript path inside. With --no-digest, the transcript and no model call.

input.description: Video URL on any site yt-dlp supports.

noDigest.description: Stop at the transcript. Makes no model call.
